eligibility.note: pre-registered before the benchmark; a cell with fewer events cannot support a rate-change test, and a cell active in fewer months cannot distinguish a change from a single filing

design.injection: post-onset counts re-drawn from a Poisson law at the injected rate; pre-onset months kept exactly as observed
design.pairing: injection seeds depend only on (cell, onset, multiplier), never on the detector, so every detector scores the identical injected series
design.selection: the full frontier is reported and no single threshold is hidden. The readout at a false-alarm budget takes the best point inside it, which is optimistic in absolute terms but symmetric across detectors
design.split: cells split by entity sha256; no entity in both halves; all reported numbers come from the evaluation half

poisson_bayes_factor.interpretation: entity-clustered paired percentile interval; the comparison is paired trial-by-trial because every detector sees the identical injected series

poisson_cusum.interpretation: entity-clustered paired percentile interval; the comparison is paired trial-by-trial because every detector sees the identical injected series

paired_comparison.note: each detector is represented by its best point inside the same realised false-alarm budget; pairing is exact because every detector scored the identical injected series
